bookmark.return_note: Matching algorithm needs spec (distance, relevance, verification level weighting). Notification workflow needed.

M.M3_hierarchy_path: Product Manager > Community > Equipment > Resource Matching

IO1_direct_inputs.name: help_request
IO1_direct_inputs.source: User or system requests help (equipment, skill, or vehicle)

IO3_transformations.algorithm: Score = (1/distance) × relevance × verification_boost. Rank by score.

DW1_upstream_pipeline.description: User requests help (calls 911 equivalent, help request system)

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Matched resource owners notified of opportunity to help

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Spatial query (find nearby resources). Relevance scoring (weighted factors). Notification delivery (many concurrent requests).
P.P2_defensibility: Distance-based (nearest first). Verification-based (trusted skills/equipment prioritized). Opt-in (matched users can decline).
P.P3_confidence_level: Medium (algorithm tuning needed). Spatial queries well-established.
P4_failure_modes: Matching returns wrong resource (algorithm tuning issue) (mitigate: user can decline, request alternative)
Owner not notified (notification failure) (mitigate: retry, show in-app alert)
Stale availability (owner marked available but resource gone) (mitigate: owner confirmation before assignment)
P.P5_backup_plan: If matching fails: show all available resources sorted by distance. If notification fails: show in-app alert.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test matching algorithm with various request types. Test notification failure. Test stale availability.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for scoring algorithm. Integration tests for spatial queries. Load tests for concurrent matching. End-to-end tests for full help request workflow.
P.P8_benchmarks: Matching: <5s for 10k nearby resources. Notification delivery: >95% within 30s. Match accuracy: top 3 matches are relevant 90%+.

L.L1_legal_considerations: Matching creates expectation of help (liability if help not provided).
L.L3_consent_requirements: Opt-in to resource matching. Owner can decline requests.
L.L4_liability_notes: No obligation for matched resources to help. Clear disclaimer needed.

F.F3_revenue_impact: Resource matching is core value prop (enables mutual aid).

S.S2_data_privacy: Request shown only to matched resources.
S.S4_access_control: Matched resources see request location (per consent). Requester sees matched resource location.

X.X1_notes: Resource matching is critical mutual aid feature. Algorithm simplicity important (distance + relevance). Owner opt-in for notifications. Stale availability is key challenge.
X2_open_questions: Scoring weights: distance vs verification level? (tune based on user feedback)
Notification: immediate or batch? (immediate = better UX, batch = less spam)
Owner confirmation: before assignment or optional? (before = better reliability)
X.X3_related_research: Matching algorithms. Spatial indexing. Notification delivery optimization. Mutual aid platforms.
